description_en: Call the ListCustomRoutingPortMappingsByDestination operation to query the port mappings of a specified backend instance for a custom route listener
description_zh: 调用ListCustomRoutingPortMappingsByDestination接口查询指定后端实例的端口映射表（自定义路由类型监听）
name: ListCustomRoutingPortMappingsByDestination

parameters.help_en: The ID of the region where the Global Accelerator instance is deployed. Set the value to **cn-hangzhou**
parameters.help_zh: 全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值**cn-hangzhou**
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Maximum value: **50**. Default value: **10**
parameters.help_zh: 分页查询时每页的条目数。最大值：**50**。默认值：**10**
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint to which the backend instance belongs
parameters.help_zh: 待查询后端实例所属的终端节点ID
parameters.name: endpoint_id

parameters.help_en: The service IP address of the backend instance
parameters.help_zh: 待查询后端实例服务IP地址
parameters.name: destination_address
